description: This file defines the PHP class WellArchitectedClient within the Aws\WellArchitected namespace. It serves as a client to interact with the AWS Well-Architected Tool service, providing method signatures (with doc comments) for various API operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: WellArchitectedClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, providing methods to interact with the AWS Well-Architected Tool API.

methods.name: associateLenses
methods.description: Associates lenses with a workload or profile.

methods.name: associateLensesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates lenses with a workload or profile.

methods.name: createWorkload
methods.description: Creates a new workload in the AWS Well-Architected Tool.

methods.name: getWorkload
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific workload.
